unknown_hours: Full UTC hours strictly inside the frozen hh:30 observation endpoints
reference: Production GFW hourly weather for conditional coherence; existing reference AIS observed AIS nearest the UTC hour within 5 minutes for separate reference comparisons
wave_denominator: Exactly the same supported M+Q hours in bounds and reference; unsupported and unavailable-reference hours excluded from both and counted
tc_denominator: Exactly the same available-reference M+Q hours in bounds and reference; no missing reference filled as zero
selection: Stable hash rank before evaluation; 36/48 h dense extensions from the existing 24 h manifest candidate pool; storm extensions retain the original storm window
interpretation: Additional diagnostic, not a production holdout-design change, confidence interval, independent physical truth, or full annual OD validation
